caption: The drawing features three main objects: a pedestal table and two detailed elements shown in separate rectangular frames at the top of the composition. The table, which occupies the majority of the lower portion of the image, is brown with elaborate woodwork. It has a shaped, undulating tabletop, a central carved pedestal adorned with vertical leaf designs, and four splayed legs each terminating in green, paw-like feet. The two details above the table display close-up views of similar carved wooden elements: the left frame contains an urn-shaped piece with vertical leaf patterns, while the right frame depicts a curved table leg or support with similar leaf motif carvings. The background is off-white, and all components have a three-dimensional, shaded appearance using brown tones for the wood, green for the feet, and varying shades for highlights and shadows. The objects are surrounded by fine lines forming rectangles around each item to separate them visually within the composition.
title: Card Table
